cites.quote: Netanyahu has the backing of 65 MKs, a majority of the 120-seat Knesset. ... Blue and White leader Benny Gantz, in contrast, has just 45. ... Yisrael Beytenu, the Union of Right-Wing Parties and Kulanu recommended him ... the ultra-Orthodox Shas and United Torah Judaism parties also recommended Netanyahu ... The left-wing Meretz party also recommended Gantz
סיעת רע"מ-בל"ד לא המליצה על אף מועמד

notes: Hadash–Ta’al and Ra’am–Balad explicitly declined to recommend a candidate, as reported after their respective consultations on 15 and 16 April 2019.

events.textEn: Rivlin tasked Netanyahu with forming a government for 28 days.
events.textHe: ריבלין הטיל על נתניהו להרכיב ממשלה בתוך 28 ימים.

cites.quote: President Reuven Rivlin on Wednesday officially tasked Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with assembling a coalition

events.textEn: Rivlin granted Netanyahu a fourteen-day extension.
events.textHe: ריבלין העניק לנתניהו הארכה של ארבעה עשר ימים.

cites.quote: extended by two weeks the deadline for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to form a new governing coalition

notes: Deadline from the 13 May notice; failure to form is evidenced by the subsequent dissolution and the IDI historical survey. No mandate-return event is inferred.
events.textEn: Netanyahu’s extended formation period reached its deadline without a new government.
events.textHe: התקופה המוארכת שניתנה לנתניהו להרכבת הממשלה הגיעה לסיומה ללא ממשלה חדשה.

cites.quote: Netanyahu will now have until May 29 to form the government

events.textEn: The Knesset passed the dissolution law, 74 for · 45 against, setting the next election for 17 September 2019. No new government was formed.
events.textHe: הכנסת קיבלה את חוק ההתפזרות, 74 בעד · 45 נגד, וקבעה בחירות ל־17 בספטמבר 2019. לא הוקמה ממשלה חדשה.

cites.quote: Once a law has been adopted for the dissolution of the Knesset, the proceedings for the formation of a government shall cease.
